types.label: Chat
types.description: Conversational chat node. Unwired → acts as the canvas orchestrator panel (no role in execution). Wiring it is not supported — use `llm-call` for a prompt→completion step.

form.label: Conversation id
form.help: Optional: pin an existing /jkai conversation to this chat node so the canvas thread "follows" the user from chat onto the canvas. Set by `pinConversationToCanvasChat` and `workflow_build_from_spec`.

types.label: Conditional
types.description: Evaluates a JS boolean expression and routes to the "true" or "false" output handle.

form.label: Condition
form.help: A yes/no test. If it is true, the workflow goes down the "true" branch; otherwise the "false" branch. Access upstream data with input.field.

types.label: Map array
types.description: Iterate an array from the input. 'map' mode applies a JS expression to each item and returns { results, count } once. 'subworkflow' mode fans each item out to a saved sub-workflow (bounded concurrency) and returns per-item results — use this when each item needs real side effects.

form.label: Mode

options.label: Sub-workflow — run a workflow per item

form.help: map = transform each item; subworkflow = invoke a saved workflow per item.

form.label: Array Path
form.help: Which field on the input holds the list. Use a dot-path like items or data.values.

form.label: Per-Item Expression
form.help: Runs once for each item. Variables: item, index, input. Return the transformed value.

form.label: Sub-workflow ID
form.help: Saved workflow invoked per item with input { item, index }.

form.label: On item failure
form.help: continue = record and keep going; stop = halt on the first failure.

form.label: Max items
form.help: Hard cap on items processed (default 50). Extra items are truncated.

form.label: Concurrency
form.help: How many items to process in parallel (map default 1, subworkflow default 3, max 10).

types.label: Delay
types.description: Wait a fixed duration, then pass input through unchanged.

form.label: Delay
form.help: Pause time in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second).

types.label: Error handler
types.description: Routes to success or error output based on error detection: checks for an explicit error field OR HTTP status codes >= 400 from upstream http-request nodes.

types.label: Interactive Step
types.description: Pauses the workflow for a human to solve a CAPTCHA, log in, or confirm data. Resumes after the human completes it from the canvas.

form.label: Mode
form.help: What kind of human interaction to show.

form.label: Prompt
form.placeholder: Please complete any CAPTCHA or log in, then click Continue.
form.help: Instruction shown to the human in the modal.

form.label: Profile Name
form.help: Must match the downstream stealth-scrape profile so the seeded cookies are shared.

form.label: URL to Open
form.help: URL to load in the headed browser. Use the target site's landing/search page.

form.label: Form Fields
form.help: Array of {name, type, label, defaultValueTemplate?} for the confirm form.

types.label: Sub-workflow
types.description: Execute another saved workflow as a step. Passes input to the sub-workflow and returns its output.

form.label: Workflow ID
form.help: The ID of the workflow to run. Find it in the URL of the workflow edit page.

types.label: Manual Trigger
types.description: Starts a workflow manually. Optionally accepts initial data.

types.label: Approval
types.description: Pauses the workflow for a human to approve or reject. On approve, the input passes through (approved: true) down the "approved" handle; on reject it routes down the "rejected" handle (approved: false).

form.label: Prompt
form.help: What the human is asked to approve or reject.

form.label: Auto-decision path
form.help: Optional. Dot-path into input holding a boolean; if set, the node decides without pausing.

form.label: Timeout (minutes)
form.help: Auto-cancel the approval after this many minutes.

types.label: Infrastructure update
types.description: Approval-gated executor for a small server-side allowlist. Refuses arbitrary commands, packages and services.

form.label: Safe action
form.help: The manifest must match this enumerable action and arrive from an approved upstream branch.

types.label: LLM call
types.description: Call an LLM. Leave the model empty to use the same default as jkai (configured in admin → model defaults). Set an OpenRouter model ID to override. System and user prompts support {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: User Prompt
form.help: What you want the AI to do. Use {{input.field}} to insert upstream data.

form.label: System Prompt
form.placeholder: You are a helpful assistant that writes concise summaries.
form.help: Optional instructions that set the AI's role or style.

form.label: Model
form.help: Leave as "Default" to use the site-wide admin default (recommended). The picker shows the full live OpenRouter catalogue.

form.label: Temperature
form.help: How creative the answers are. 0 is focused and deterministic, 2 is wild.

form.label: Max Tokens
form.help: Maximum length of the AI response (roughly 4 characters per token).

form.label: Output JSON schema (optional)
form.help: Set to force a structured JSON response. The parsed object is returned under `data`; top-level `required` keys are validated with one retry.

types.label: LLM agent (tool-calling)
types.description: Multi-turn LLM agent that can use connected downstream nodes as tools. Loops until the LLM responds without tool calls, or hits iteration/token/timeout limits.

form.label: User Prompt
form.help: The main instruction for the agent. Use {{input.field}} to reference incoming data.

form.label: System Prompt
form.help: Sets the agent's role and behaviour. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Model
form.help: Leave as "Default" to use the site-wide admin default (recommended). Only pick a specific model to override.

form.label: Temperature
form.help: Lower = more focused, higher = more creative

form.label: Max Tokens
form.help: Maximum length of each LLM response

form.label: Max Iterations
form.help: Max tool-use loop iterations

form.label: Max Total Tokens
form.help: Total token budget across all iterations (0 = unlimited)

form.label: Timeout (ms)
form.help: Max execution time in milliseconds (0 = disabled)

form.label: Tool source
form.help: Edges = every downstream connected node becomes a tool. Site tools = an allowlist of non-destructive registry tools (no wiring needed).

form.label: Allowed site tools
form.help: Exact registry tool names the agent may call (e.g. file_search, research_search, render_chart). Destructive/denylisted tools are always excluded.

form.label: Tool Overrides
form.help: JSON object mapping node IDs to { name?, description? } to override tool definitions.

types.label: Delegate to agent
types.description: Delegate a task to a named specialist agent from the persistent team (researcher, analyst, writer, reviewer, or any custom agent). The agent runs a full tool-using turn with its persona and tool whitelist; the node returns its response.

form.label: Agent
form.help: Team agent name/slug (see /jkai/agents). Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Task
form.placeholder: Summarise the key findings in {{input.text}} and note anything surprising.
form.help: What the agent should do. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

types.label: LLM router
types.description: LLM-powered semantic routing. Defines named output paths; the LLM picks which to follow.

form.label: Routes
form.help: List of possible routes as JSON. Each entry needs `handle` (matches source handle on this node) and `description` (when to pick it).

form.label: Model
form.help: Leave as "Default" to use the site-wide admin default (recommended). Only pick a specific model to override.

types.label: Think
types.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning. LLM reasons step-by-step, outputs reasoning + conclusion.

form.label: Reasoning Task
form.placeholder: Analyze the data and determine the best course of action.
form.help: What you want the LLM to think about. Use {{input.field}} to reference incoming data.

form.label: Model
form.help: Leave as "Default" to use the site-wide admin default (recommended). Only pick a specific model to override — prefer full OpenRouter slugs (e.g. z-ai/glm-5.2, openai/gpt-4o).

form.label: Temperature
form.help: Lower = more focused, higher = more creative

form.label: Max Tokens
form.help: Maximum length of the LLM response

types.label: OpenRouter
types.description: OpenRouter integration: chat completion with model picker, list available models, or get API usage stats.

form.label: Action
form.help: What to do with OpenRouter

form.label: Model
form.help: Which LLM runs this step. Leave as "Default" to use the site-wide admin default (recommended). Full live OpenRouter catalogue available in the picker.

form.label: System Prompt
form.help: Instructions that set behaviour/persona. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: User Prompt
form.help: The user message. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Creativity (temperature)
form.help: 0 = deterministic, 1 = balanced, 2 = very creative

form.label: Max Tokens
form.help: Upper limit on response length

types.label: Text parser (JSON / regex)
types.description: Extract structured data from text: JSON extraction, regex matching, or text splitting.

form.label: Mode
form.help: How to parse the text

form.label: Input Field
form.help: Field name on the input object to parse

form.label: Pattern
form.help: Regular expression to match against the text

form.label: Flags
form.help: Regex flags (e.g. `g` for global, `i` for case-insensitive)

form.label: Delimiter
form.help: Use \n for newline

types.label: Validator (schema)
types.description: Validate data against a JSON Schema or JS expression. Routes to pass/fail outputs.

form.label: Mode
form.help: How to validate the incoming data

form.label: Expression
form.help: JavaScript boolean expression. Use `input.field` to reference data.

form.label: Schema
form.help: Define the expected fields, types, and which are required.

types.label: Transform (JS)
types.description: Reshape data with a JavaScript expression. The input object is available as `input`.

form.label: Transform Expression
form.help: JavaScript function body. Use `input` to access upstream data and return a new object.

form.label: Output Schema (JSON)
form.help: Optional JSON schema describing the output shape. Helps downstream nodes show autocomplete.

types.label: Code execute
types.description: Run JavaScript, Python, or Bash code in a sandboxed environment.

form.label: Language
form.help: Which interpreter runs your code

form.label: Code
form.help: Input from the previous node is available as `input`. Print or return JSON to pass data downstream.

form.label: Output shape (optional)
form.help: JSON schema describing what your code returns — enables autocomplete on downstream nodes.

types.label: Merge
types.description: Combine the outputs of every upstream node into a single object. Use after parallel branches converge. Keys are merged flat — if two branches emit the same key, one overwrites the other.

types.label: Accumulator
types.description: Wrap the current input (or a chosen field) into an array within this run. Does NOT persist or accumulate across separate runs.

form.label: Field to Collect
form.help: Dot-path into input to collect. Leave empty to collect the entire input object.

types.label: Dedupe
types.description: Filter a list against a persistent seen-set so only genuinely new items continue downstream. Remembers ids across runs — the workflow never re-processes (or re-sends) the same item twice.

form.label: Items path
form.help: Dot-path to the array in the input (e.g. "results"). Leave empty to auto-detect the first array value.

form.label: Id path
form.help: Dot-path to the unique id within each item (e.g. "url"). Empty → tries "url" then "id"; primitive items are their own id.

form.label: Store key
form.help: data-store key holding the seen-id set (default "seen_ids").

form.label: Max remembered
form.help: Cap the seen-set to the most recent N ids (default 500).

form.label: Record mode
form.help: 'immediate' records new ids as they pass through (default). 'downstream-success' records only after the whole run completes successfully — so a failed send does not mark items as seen.

types.label: Briefing compose
types.description: Turn gathered signals into a verified fact sheet, an explicit gap list, and a per-source status ledger. Everything a downstream LLM is allowed to say, and nothing it is not.

form.label: Title prefix
form.help: Used to build the briefing title, e.g. "Briefing — Tue 29 Jul".

form.label: Timezone
form.help: Timezone for the date label.

form.label: Audit this run
form.help: Read the run's node executions so failed sources appear in the ledger with their real error, instead of just going missing.

types.label: Intelligence
types.description: Filtered view onto the knowledge graph. Queryable; emits both prose context and a structured IntelItem[].

form.label: Query
form.help: What to look up. {{input.field}} placeholders supported.

types.label: Research Result
types.description: Display node for a commissioned deep/quick research session. Pulses while pending; populates when complete.

form.label: Session ID
form.help: Existing session ID. Supports {{input.*}} placeholders from an upstream connection.

types.label: Quick Answer
types.description: Run a quick-answer session (Tavily + synthesis). Polls until complete; returns the answer and sources.

form.label: Topic
form.help: Topic to research. Supports {{input.*}} / {{item.*}} placeholders.

form.label: Goals
form.help: Optional: specific questions or angles. One per line.

form.label: Max wait (ms)
form.help: Polling deadline before giving up.

types.label: Deep Research
types.description: DAG-driven deep research (commission via pipeline). Emits researchReport + sources.

form.label: Topic
form.help: Topic to research deeply. Supports {{input.*}} / {{item.*}} placeholders.

form.label: Goals
form.help: Optional: specific angles or questions. One per line.

form.label: Max wait (ms)
form.help: Polling deadline before giving up.

types.label: File search (RAG)
types.description: Semantic search across the CONTENT of every file in the /drive store — text by meaning, images by visual content + OCR, audio by transcript. Returns ranked passages with the source file name and id.

form.label: Search query
form.help: What to find, by what the file contains or depicts. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Max results
form.help: Number of ranked passages to return (1–30).

form.label: Modality filter
form.help: Comma-separated modalities to keep (text / image / audio). Blank keeps all.

types.label: Research search (RAG)
types.description: Semantic search across the MATERIALS of every deep-dive research session at once — distilled facts AND raw source passages — ranked by meaning. Cross-session research memory for grounding a workflow.

form.label: Search query
form.placeholder: what has my research turned up about school funding
form.help: What to find across all past deep-dive research. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Max results
form.help: Number of ranked passages to return (1–30).

types.label: Intel · query
types.description: Search the intel knowledge graph; appends matching context as intelContext to downstream input.

form.label: Query
form.help: What to look up. {{input.field}} placeholders supported.

types.label: Intel · write
types.description: Add a note to the jkai/intel knowledge store. The note is extracted into entities + relationships, embedded for semantic search, and connected to the graph. Use for persisting findings (articles, summaries, observations) from a workflow so they contribute to future context and cross-reference alerts.

form.label: Title
form.help: Optional. Falls back to the derived summary.

form.label: Content
form.help: The body of the note. This is what gets embedded and extracted.

form.label: Format
form.help: Hint to the intel extractor about what kind of content this is.

form.label: Source tag
form.help: Stored in metadata for filtering later.

form.label: Source URL
form.help: Canonical URL for provenance.

form.label: Extra metadata (JSON)
form.help: Optional JSON merged into the note metadata.

types.label: Tavily search
types.description: Search the web via Tavily. Returns ranked results with URL, title, content snippet, and optional AI-generated answer.

form.label: Search Query
form.help: What to search for. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Search Depth
form.help: Trade-off between speed/cost and result quality

form.label: Max Results
form.help: Number of results to return (1–20).

form.label: Include AI Summary Answer
form.help: Return a Tavily-generated summary alongside the results.

form.label: Topic
form.help: Use "news" to bias toward recent press coverage and unlock the recency filter.

form.label: Recency (days)
form.help: Only return results from the last N days. 0 disables. Only applied when topic = "news".

form.label: Exclude Domains
form.help: Comma-separated domains to block from results (e.g. "example.com, spam.io")

types.label: Web scrape
types.description: Fetch a URL and extract the readable article text using Mozilla Readability. Strips nav, ads, and chrome.

form.label: URL
form.help: Web page to fetch. Must start with http:// or https://. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Max Characters
form.help: Truncate extracted text to this many characters. 0 = no limit.

types.label: Webpage
types.description: Render a live webpage inside the canvas (falls back to a proxy for sites that block framing).

types.label: HTTP request
types.description: Make an HTTP request. URL, headers, and body support {{input.field}} template variables. Optional pagination auto-follows pages.

types.label: Stealth Scrape
types.description: Scrape a web page (or paginated set) using a stealth headless browser with a persistent profile. Residential IP via homeserv.

form.label: URL
form.help: Starting URL. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Profile Name
form.help: Stable per-domain identifier. Cookies and session data persist under this name. Must match the interactive-step profile if used.

form.label: Extract Fields
form.help: Array of {field, selector, attr?, multi?, trim?} objects defining what to pull from each page.

form.label: Wait Condition
form.help: {type: "networkidle"} | {type: "selector", selector: ".foo"} | {type: "timeout", ms: 2000}

form.label: Pagination
form.help: Optional. {type: "next-link", nextSelector: "a.next", maxPages: 5} or {type: "url-template", template: "https://site?page={n}", start: 1, maxPages: 10}

form.label: Login Credential
form.help: Row id from scraper_credentials table if the site requires form login.

types.label: Stealth Scrape (LLM Extract)
types.description: Extracts structured fields from scraped HTML/text via an LLM. Use when CSS selectors are too brittle.

form.label: Source Path
form.help: Dot path to the string or array in the input to extract from (e.g. output from stealth-scrape).

form.label: Item Text Path
form.help: When sourcePath is an array of objects, the property inside each to read as text (e.g. "text" or "html").

form.label: Extraction Schema
form.help: JSON Schema describing the fields to extract. The LLM will populate this shape from the source text.

form.label: Extra Instructions
form.placeholder: Return null for any field not clearly stated.
form.help: Optional guidance appended to the extraction prompt.

types.label: Site Mapper (LLM)
types.description: One-shot: an LLM inspects the target website and writes a deterministic scraper playbook (URL template + wait condition + extract rules) into scraper_target_knowledge. Every future stealth-scrape run against that domain follows the playbook without another LLM call, so unattended cron runs stay fast and cheap.

form.label: Seed URL
form.help: The page the mapper loads first. Usually the site's search or listing page.

form.label: Goal (what to extract)
form.placeholder: data engineer job listings with title, organisation, salary, closing date, link
form.help: Plain-English description the LLM uses to decide selectors + URL pattern.

form.label: Search query (optional)
form.help: Substituted into the playbook's {{keyword}} placeholder during validation.

form.label: Profile Name
form.help: Shared with stealth-scrape so cookies (e.g. cookie-consent) carry over.

types.label: Gmail Trigger
types.description: Fires when a new Gmail message matches a watched query

form.label: Gmail Account
form.help: The gmail_accounts row id for the account to watch. Configure accounts at /admin/connections/gmail.

form.label: Watch Filter (optional)
form.help: Restrict to a specific gmail_watches row. If blank, the trigger fires for any matching message on the account.

types.label: WhatsApp Trigger
types.description: Fires when an inbound WhatsApp message from the owner matches a keyword

form.label: Keyword
form.help: The word that routes an inbound WhatsApp message to this workflow. Case-insensitive. Only ONE workflow should own a keyword. Reserved words (approve/deny/yes/no) can't be used — they belong to the approval flow.

form.label: Match Mode

options.label: Prefix — message starts with the keyword

form.help: How the inbound message is matched against the keyword.

form.label: Strip keyword from message
form.help: Remove the keyword before forwarding the rest of the text as {{input.message}}. Turn off to forward the full message.

types.label: Gmail · Fetch Message
types.description: Fetch a Gmail message by id, returning full headers + text/html bodies + attachment refs.

form.label: Message ID
form.help: Gmail message id to fetch. Typically passed from gmail-trigger or gmail-search output.

form.label: Gmail Account
form.help: Account to fetch from. Use 0 to inherit from upstream trigger output (recommended).

types.label: Gmail · Send Message
types.description: Compose and send a new Gmail message. Supports template interpolation for recipient, subject, and body.

form.label: Gmail Account
form.help: The gmail_accounts row id for the sending account.

form.label: To
form.help: Recipient address. Supports {{input.x}} templates.

form.label: Subject
form.help: Email subject line. Supports templates.

form.label: Body (plain text)
form.help: Plain-text email body. Supports templates.

form.label: Body (HTML)
form.help: HTML email body. If both bodyText and bodyHtml are set, both parts are sent.

form.label: CC
form.help: Optional CC address(es).

types.label: Gmail · Reply
types.description: Send a reply to an existing Gmail thread, preserving In-Reply-To and References headers for proper threading.

form.label: Gmail Account
form.help: The gmail_accounts row id for the sending account.

form.label: To
form.help: Recipient address. Typically {{trigger.output.from}} to reply to the sender.

form.label: Thread ID
form.help: Gmail thread id to reply in. Taken from trigger or fetch output.

form.label: In-Reply-To
form.help: RFC 822 Message-ID of the message being replied to. Needed for proper threading.

form.label: Subject
form.help: Subject line. Usually the original subject (Re: is added automatically by mail clients).

form.label: Body (plain text)
form.help: Plain-text reply body. Supports templates.

types.label: Gmail · Modify Labels
types.description: Add or remove Gmail labels on a message. Common uses: archive (remove INBOX), mark read (remove UNREAD), star (add STARRED).

form.label: Gmail Account
form.help: The gmail_accounts row id.

form.label: Message ID
form.help: Gmail message id to label. Typically from trigger or search output.

form.label: Labels to Add
form.help: Array of label ids to apply. System labels: "STARRED", "IMPORTANT". Custom label ids visible in /admin/connections/gmail.

form.label: Labels to Remove
form.help: Array of label ids to remove. Use ["INBOX"] to archive, ["UNREAD"] to mark as read.

types.label: Gmail · Search Messages
types.description: Search Gmail using a query string. Returns matching message ids, and optionally fetches full message content.

form.label: Gmail Account
form.help: The gmail_accounts row id to search in.

form.label: Search Query
form.help: Gmail search query. Supports Gmail advanced search operators and {{input.x}} templates.

form.label: Max Results
form.help: Maximum number of messages to return (default 50).

form.label: Fetch Full Messages
form.help: If enabled, returns full body and attachments for each result. Slower for large sets.

types.label: WhatsApp · send
types.description: Send a WhatsApp message (Markdown-aware, auto-chunked, optional media). To/message fields support {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Recipient Phone Number
form.help: Phone number in E.164 format (include country code). Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Message
form.help: Text to send. Supports {{input.field}} templates. Markdown is converted to WhatsApp formatting when enabled.

form.label: Convert Markdown
form.help: **bold** → *bold*, ## headings → bold lines, [links](url) → text (url), - bullets → •.

form.label: Max chunks
form.help: Split long messages (>4096 chars) into at most this many sends. 0 = no cap.

form.label: Suppress duplicates (mins)
form.help: Skip an identical message to the same recipient within this many minutes. 0 = off.

form.label: Category (owner only)
form.help: When the recipient is you, the message is routed by this notification category (WhatsApp and/or iPhone). Default: Everything else.

form.label: Media file path
form.help: Local file to send as an attachment. Requires the WhatsApp worker.

form.label: Media URL
form.help: URL to download and send as an attachment.

form.label: Media caption
form.help: Caption for the attachment. Falls back to the message text.

types.label: Email · send
types.description: Send an email via SMTP. To, subject, and body support {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Recipient
form.help: Who the email goes to. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Subject
form.help: Subject line. Supports templates.

form.label: Body
form.help: Email body. If it starts with an HTML tag it is sent as HTML, otherwise as plain text.

form.label: From Address
form.help: Override the sender address. Leave blank to use the server default (SMTP_FROM).

types.label: jkai · message
types.description: Manage JKAI autonomous builds: start, check status, list, and control.

form.label: Action
form.help: What to do with JKAI autonomous builds

form.label: Prompt
form.help: Description of what you want JKAI to build.

form.label: Title
form.help: Optional friendly name for this build.

form.label: Build ID
form.help: ID of the build to check or control.

form.label: Control Action
form.help: What to do with the build

types.label: Deck build (presentation)
types.description: Publish workflow results as an sr. decks presentation (/decks/<slug>) from a block-deck spec. Returns the deck url + share link so a downstream whatsapp/email node can send it.

form.label: Title
form.help: Deck title. Supports {{input.field}} / {{today}} templates.

form.label: Description
form.help: Optional one-line description. Template-supported.

form.label: Slides spec (JSON)
form.help: A JSON array of slides (or { slides: [...] }). String leaves support {{input.*}} templates.

form.label: Include share link
form.help: Return a view-granting share URL in the output.

form.label: Publish publicly
form.help: Make the deck public immediately (default private).

types.label: API call (catalogue)
types.description: Read / write / update / push / pull from a registered API in the catalogue. Pick an API by name, choose an operation (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), and give a path relative to its baseUrl. Auth is injected server-side; every request is SSRF-guarded and kept within the API's baseUrl.

form.label: API
form.help: Catalogue key or name of the registered API. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Operation
form.help: What to do against the API.

form.label: Path
form.help: Path relative to the API's baseUrl. May include a ?query. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Body (JSON)
form.help: Request body for write/update methods. Ignored for GET. Supports templates.

form.label: Query params (JSON)
form.help: Optional JSON object of query params merged into the URL.

form.label: Extra headers (JSON)
form.help: Optional JSON object of extra request headers. Auth is added automatically.

types.label: API integration
types.description: Call a registered API integration by name. Pick one from the register — parameters become labelled fields and the response arrives as named values, so no JSON-path wiring is needed.

form.label: Integration
form.help: Key of the registered integration to call.

form.label: Allow write operation
form.help: Required for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE integrations — they change data on the remote API.

types.label: Home Assistant
types.description: Control Home Assistant: query state, call services, fire events, get history, render templates.

types.label: Whoop
types.description: Access Whoop health data. Requires Whoop connected in Health settings. Prefer DB-backed ops (get_summary, get_recent, query_recovery) — they are fast and free; *_api ops hit the Whoop API directly.

form.label: Action
form.help: What to do

form.label: Days
form.help: Trailing window in days. Used by Summary / Recent.

form.label: Metric
form.help: Which metric series to return.

form.label: Limit
form.help: Maximum number of records to return (API ops).

form.label: Start Date
form.help: ISO 8601 start date filter (optional).

form.label: End Date
form.help: ISO 8601 end date filter (optional).

types.label: Health query
types.description: Query health data from Apple Watch, Whoop and other fitness sources.

form.label: Action
form.help: Which health data summary to fetch

form.label: Page
form.help: Page number for paginated timeline results.

form.label: Items Per Page
form.help: How many activities to return per page.

types.label: Location context
types.description: Resolve where home is and where the person actually is right now, from Home Assistant. Returns both coordinate pairs plus distance, place label and staleness — the input for location-aware weather and briefings.

form.label: Person / tracker entity
form.help: The Home Assistant person or device_tracker whose position you want. Supports {{input.field}}.

form.label: Home zone entity
form.help: Zone that defines "home". Its coordinates are returned as the home position.

form.label: Stale after (minutes)
form.help: Mark the position stale when the tracker has not reported within this window.

types.label: Weather brief
types.description: Decoded weather for a coordinate pair (Open-Meteo). Returns named conditions, metric temperatures, rain/wind/UV and derived "local factors" — no raw WMO codes for a downstream LLM to guess at.

form.label: Place name
form.help: What to call this location in the output. Supports {{input.field}}.

form.label: Latitude
form.help: Decimal latitude. Feed from a location-context node for "where I am right now".

form.label: Longitude
form.help: Decimal longitude.

form.label: Timezone
form.help: IANA timezone used for the day window and sunrise/sunset.

types.label: Data store (KV)
types.description: Workflow-scoped key-value store. Persists across runs. Get/set plus atomic append, add-to-set (dedupe), has, increment, and delete.

form.label: Action
form.help: What to do with the stored value.

form.label: Key
form.help: Name of the stored item. Supports {{input.field}} templates so keys can be dynamic.

form.label: Value Path
form.help: Dot-path into the input to pick the value (e.g. data.count). Leave empty to use input.value or the whole input.

form.label: Amount
form.help: How much to add to the counter (default 1).

form.label: Max items
form.help: Cap the list/set to the most recent N elements (oldest trimmed).

form.label: Default
form.help: Value returned when the key is not found (get only).

form.label: Merge into input
form.help: Output the whole input with the looked-up value merged in (get only).

form.label: Output key
form.help: Key the looked-up value is merged under when Merge-into-input is on.

types.label: Database
types.description: Permanent, sitewide datastore. Full CRUD over jsonb records in named collections: insert / upsert / get / query (filter DSL) / update / patch / delete / count / aggregate. Shared across workflows (unlike the per-workflow Data store).

form.label: Operation
form.help: What to do against the datastore.

form.label: Collection
form.help: Collection slug. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Auto-create collection
form.help: Create the collection on first write if it does not exist.

form.label: Key
form.help: Natural key of the record. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Data (JSON)
form.help: JSON object of the record body. Supports {{input.field}} templates.

form.label: Patch (JSON)
form.help: JSON object of fields to shallow-merge onto the existing record.

form.label: Filters (JSON)
form.help: JSON array of { path, op, value }. op ∈ eq|ne|gt|gte|lt|lte|contains|exists|in.

form.label: Sort field
form.help: Sort by a built-in column (ignored when Sort path is set).

form.label: Sort path
form.help: Sort by a dot-path into the record data (overrides Sort field).

form.label: Limit
form.help: Max records to return (1–500, default 100).

form.label: Offset
form.help: Records to skip.

form.label: Aggregate path
form.help: Dot-path to the numeric field (required for sum/avg/min/max).

form.label: Group by
form.help: Optional dot-path to group aggregate results by.

form.label: Row permissions (JSON)
form.help: Optional { read?, write?, delete? } actor lists on this record. Actors: owner, jkai, system, workflow:<id>, workflow:*, *.

form.label: Expected version
form.help: Optimistic concurrency: fail if the stored version differs.

form.label: Output key
form.help: Key the result is placed under (default records/record/result by operation).

types.label: Inspector · debug
types.description: Runtime debug view. Captures the upstream node's output and renders it as JSON, tables, HTML, images, video, audio, or plain text.

form.label: Size
form.help: Rendered width/height (user-resizable).

types.label: Site Tool
types.description: Invoke any registered site capability (a "site tool") by name — presentations/decks, publish page, media generation, personal memory, diagnostics, RAG search, and more. Args are JSON with {{input.*}} templates. Destructive tools require an upstream approval node.

form.label: Tool name
form.help: Exact registered tool name (e.g. "presentation_build_from_spec", "save_memory", "render_chart"). Must match the tool's registry name.

form.label: Args
form.help: Arguments object matching the tool's parameter schema. String leaves support {{input.*}} / {{state.*}} / {{today}} / {{now}} templates.

form.label: Allow destructive
form.help: Required for destructive tools (send/publish/delete-class). When true you MUST also place an approval node upstream on this node's path — enforced at author time and at run time.

types.label: Notify me
types.description: Tell the owner something under a notification category. The category's route (set on the phone) decides WhatsApp, iPhone, both or neither, and every raise is written to the notification ledger.

form.label: Category
form.help: Routes to WhatsApp and/or the iPhone per the category's settings.

types.label: Read file
types.description: Load a file from the workflow file store. Returns content as utf8 (default) or base64.

form.label: File name
form.help: Supports {{input.field}}.

form.label: Encoding
form.help: utf8 for text, base64 for binary.

types.label: Write file
types.description: Create or overwrite a file in the workflow store. Set `append: true` to append to an existing file instead.

form.label: File name
form.help: Supports {{input.field}}.

form.label: Append mode
form.help: When on, append to an existing file (does not create).

form.label: Encoding
form.help: utf8 for text, base64 for binary.

form.label: Content path
form.help: Dot-path into input.

types.label: Delete file
types.description: Remove a file from the workflow file store. Idempotent — silently succeeds if the file is already gone.

form.label: File name
form.help: Supports {{input.field}}.

types.label: List files
types.description: List every file in the workflow store, optionally filtered by name prefix.

form.label: Name prefix
form.help: Optional. Empty lists all files.

types.label: Extract text from file
types.description: Pull plain text + structured metadata out of a PDF / DOCX / Markdown / audio / video file in the workflow file store.

form.label: Source file
form.help: Name of the file in the store.

form.label: First page (PDF)
form.help: Optional. 1-indexed.

form.label: Last page (PDF)
form.help: Optional. Inclusive.

form.label: Language (audio/video)
form.help: BCP-47 hint.

form.label: Save as new .txt
form.help: Persist the extracted text to the file store.

form.label: Saved file name
form.help: Required when "Save as new .txt" is on.

types.label: Build new file
types.description: Synthesise a new file (docx / pdf / html / xlsx / csv) from text / markdown / json / csv / xlsx input.

form.label: Output format
form.help: What kind of file to produce.

form.label: Input format
form.help: Format of the content you are providing.

form.label: Content path
form.help: Dot-path into input. Default `input.content`.

form.label: Title
form.help: Optional title for docx/pdf.

form.label: Save to file store
form.help: When on, the output becomes a new workflow file.

form.label: Saved file name
form.help: Required when "Save to file store" is on.

types.label: Apple Calendar
types.description: Read and write events on iCloud calendars via CalDAV.

types.label: Infrastructure status
types.description: Read-only current-to-latest infrastructure review. Uses bounded official publisher releases and explicitly labels unavailable evidence.

form.label: Audit scope

form.help: Durable audit records retained for this workflow.

types.label: Builder Chat
types.description: Set the build outcome and config. Programmatic: starts a JKAI build with the configured prompt and emits the buildId.

form.help: Build outcome prompt. Supports templates.

types.label: Builder Pi
types.description: Live terminal for an active build. Programmatic: waits for the build to reach a terminal state (completed/failed/paused) and emits its final snapshot.

form.label: Build id
form.help: Target build id (templates supported).

form.label: Poll interval ms
form.help: Poll interval while waiting for terminal state.

form.label: Max wait ms
form.help: Max wait before bailing out.

types.label: Build View
types.description: Snapshot of an in-progress or finished JKAI build (status, preview URL, published slug).

form.label: Build id
